main_text.l: Præputium. Plural. עָרְלָתָא, עָרְלָן.
עָרַם Hebr. Calliditate, Astu usus fuit. Hinc Ch. in
Ithpehal מִתְעָרִים Astutus fiet, Prov.19.25.
עָרִימָא, עָרִימָאי, עָרִים Ch. Astutus, callidus. Plur. constr.
עָרִימֵאי Prov.14.18.
עָרִימוּתָא Ch. Astutia, Calliditas.
עָרְמוּתָא Ch. Idem, 1.Reg.2.5.
עֲרִימְתָא, עֲרִימָא Chald. Acervus, cumulus. Plur. עֲרִימָן, עֲרִימְתָא.
עוּרְמָא Ch. Idem. Plur. עוּרְמָן, Exo.15.8. in Jon.
ܥܪܡܐ Syr. Idem: ܥܪܡܐ ܥܪܡܬܐ ܥܪܡܢ Et erit
tumulus, humilis, Lucæ 3.5.
עָרֵם עַרְסָא, עַרְסָא Ch. & Syr. Lectus, Sponda lecti: Itē
Feretrum, lectus mortui, 2.Sam.3.31. & sic Syr.
Luc.7.14. Plur.fœmin. עַרְסָן, & ex forma masc. עַרְסִין
Thren.2.21. cum affix. עַרְסִיהוֹן Amos 6.4.
עַרְסְלָא עַרְסַל Ch. Lectulus, cubile vagum, quod de lo-
co in locum movetur, Jesa.1.8. & 24.20. ubi per ɾ
scribitur.
עַרַע Ch. Accidere, incidere, offendere, continge-
re, obviam venire, occurrere, incurrere, eve-
nire. Pahel עָרַע Idem: Item Convocare, indicare,
coetum, conventum aut diem festivum: Item Per-
tingere, contingere, attingere. Ithpahel אִתְעָרַע Ob-
viam fieri, occurrere, incidere.
עִירוּעָא Ch. Accidens, eventus, casus.
עַרְעִיתָא Chald. Idem, Eccles.9.11. Item Crabro, Hebr.
צִרְעָה, mutato ɾ in ɣ.
מַעֲרָעָא, מַעֲרַע Ch. Convocatio, coetus, conventus solennis.
